analyst_view.overall: OFI Crete (16th, 6 pts) host Anderlecht (15th, 6 pts) in Heraklion, a direct fight for a play-off place between two sides on two wins from four. OFI's squad, named on Wednesday, is without Kenan Kodro and Aaron Iseka (injured), Borja Gonzalez (quadriceps) and Achilleas Pougouras (surgery for appendicitis); Kodro is on the numbers' list, but Gonzalez and Pougouras are not. Kresimir Krizmanic, whom the numbers count as out, is back in OFI's squad, so their defence is stronger than the numbers assume. Anderlecht coach Vitor Bruno says his squad is fully fit apart from Ilay Camara, who was ill and is doubtful (both Camara and Lucas Hey are counted); Anderlecht have won their last two European games. Estonian referee Kristo Tohver, about 5.3 cards a game in his few matches on file, is in charge, and the numbers already count him.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals and add about 6% to Anderlecht because Krizmanic is listed out, but he is back in OFI's squad, so that addition is too big. OFI also lose forward Borja Gonzalez, who is not on the numbers' list, on top of Kodro (counted), so I go lower, to about 2.3.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, already up for OFI conceding many corners lately (35 in four). Bruno expects OFI to switch between sitting deep and building play, and Anderlecht should have more of the ball, as the numbers already show, so I stay at 9.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards and already add about 11% for referee Kristo Tohver's high card count (5.3 a game in six matches). A tight game for a play-off place can bring bookings, but that is already in the numbers, so I stay at 4.4.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.4 shots, already lower for OFI's thin recent shooting (28 in four) and higher for Anderlecht's. Losing Gonzalez, who is not counted, takes a little more from OFI's attack, so I trim to about 25.9.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.7 shots on target, raised for Anderlecht against an OFI side that has allowed 33 on target in six. With Krizmanic back at the back for OFI and Gonzalez missing up front, I go slightly lower, to about 9.4.
